| | | Friend -- My name is Martin Sheen, though you may remember me as President Bartlet from _The West Wing._

I'm reaching out because Election Day is fast approaching. Republican megadonors are spending _millions_ to replace Democratic senators with their MAGA candidates. Control of the Senate and the future of democracy itself are on the line. _Yes, it really is that serious._

The GOP only needs to flip TWO seats to take control -- and polls show a _lot_ more Democrats than that are locked in _frighteningly close_ races against Republican candidates. We can't let the GOP have its way in ANY of these key races.

**But we don't have many chances left to make a difference -- and with the DSCC's next urgent fundraising deadline coming up tomorrow, we need to act NOW.**

**[So, I'm humbly asking: Will you pitch in $5 or whatever you can afford to support Democrats? | Peter,

Democrat Hilary Franz is running for Congress to bring the same dedication and commitment she's shown as our Commissioner of Public Lands to Washington’s 6th Congressional District. _With just**one day left until our final end-of-quarter FEC deadline** before the primary election, she needs your support to ensure we have the resources to win._

As Commissioner of Public Lands, Democrat Hilary Franz has worked tirelessly to protect our environment, restore our forests, and tackle the housing crisis. Now, she's running to represent Washington's 6th Congressional District to bring that same dedication to the other Washington.

Under Hilary's leadership, Washington's Department of Natural Resources has:
* Launched the Keep Washington Evergreen Initiative, aiming to restore one million acres of forest and conserve another million acres from development. This initiative has already made significant progress, helping to mitigate the impact of climate change and protect our natural heritage.
* Led efforts to fight wildfires and improve our response capabilities, ensuring the safety of our communities and preserving our lands for future generations. Together, we've established Washington as a national leader in wildfire fighting.
* Worked to create good-paying jobs and support our local economies. That's why she has the backing of 40 labor organizations and 17 Tribes and is the only candidate in this race endorsed by firefighters across the district.

Hilary is ready to take her bold vision and relentless commitment to Congress. But she can’t do it alone. We’ve raised over $1.1 million so far, but we need to meet our **$100,000 FEC fundraising goal** to keep our campaign on track to win our August primary.

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: they’re worried
body:
It's clear Democrats are running scared about the upcoming elections in November...
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

With President Biden stumbling in the polls, the Abortion Lobby is becoming more and more desperate.

And young voters – a demographic media elites believe the pro-abortion Left SHOULD own – are a big reason why.

In fact, pro-abortion U.S. Rep. Emanuel Cleaver (D-MO) recently said of the Democrat party’s inability to appeal to young voters, _“We’re not doing well. If the election were held tomorrow, it would be a major problem.”_

Even _Politico_ writes that _“Dems are in full-blown ‘freakout’ over Biden.”_

**Why is all this happening, Pro-Life Friend?**

It’s because of YOUR support for our efforts to turn young people AGAINST abortion-on-demand!

Now, with the June 30th **End of Quarter** rapidly approaching, I’m writing to ask you to please KEEP IT UP!

**[Will you please agree to your most generous contribution today](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.createsend7.com/t/j-l-gydvuy-duchtdja-y/)?**

I hope you will . . .

All of the successes we’ve had together won’t matter one bit, if we don’t finish 2024 strong.

If the Abortion Lobby reinstalls their puppet President Joe Biden in the White House, seizes back control of the House, and holds their Senate Majority, they will immediately move to:

**>>> _Force abortion-on-demand throughout all nine months of a pregnancy on every state in the country_** – and force hardworking taxpayers like you and me to pay for it;

**>>> _Force EVERYONE who works in the medical field to commit abortions on demand_ ,** removing any and all “conscience” protections for doctors, nurses, and pharmacists;

**>>> _Outlaw Pregnancy Help Centers _(also known as Crisis Pregnancy Centers or “CPCs”)__** for daring to help women choose Life. Senator Elizabeth Warren (D-MA) has already introduced the _“Stop Anti-Abortion Disinformation Act”_ to muzzle pro-lifers and even stated on the Senate floor that, “Deception is at the heart of many CPCs;” and

**>>> _IMPEACH Supreme Court Justices _(or else pack the Court)_ to ensure NO ONE can stand in their way_.** As one headline from _The Nation_ put it, “Impeach Samuel Alito! Impeach Clarence Thomas!”
The fact is, the stakes are higher than ever.

The media and the Abortion Lobby all want to know if we have the muscle to beat them – and this **End of Quarter** Push is going to say a lot about where we stand.

**If you can help us reach our fundraising goals,_Students for Life Action_ will roll out an UNSTOPPABLE election year program to continue all of the successes your support has enabled!**

Two years ago, after pro-lifers lost the state’s referendum in Kansas, a friend of mine at the Republican National Committee told me, _“We lost because we lost your demographic – young people. We aren’t communicating with them.”_

Ever since then, _Students for Life Action_ has doubled down on all of our efforts with young people.

And our efforts are working.

And _Students for Life Action_ is making that happen because we have boots on the ground in every big city and small town in America – and we’re not just sitting in some cushy office in Washington, D.C.

Young people can see the clear difference between us and pro-abortion radicals just as clearly as you can.

With your support, _Students for Life Action_ doesn’t just talk about change, we make it.

But we can’t sustain momentum without your help.

**[So, please agree to your most generous contribution to _Students for Life Action’s_ End of Quarter Push](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.createsend7.com/t/j-l-gydvuy-duchtdja-j/)!**

**Let’s make 2024 the year we slammed the door on _Planned Parenthood’s_ political pals.**

Pro-Life Friend, thanks for all you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

body:
Making sure you see this.

Hey Peter, it’s Josh’s campaign manager.
Wanted to make sure you saw this email about the meeting we had with Josh.
Even though we just got a poll showing us down by 1 point, he said we can’t launch our ads unless we reach our end-of-quarter goal. Right now we’re still $8,500 away and the deadline is tomorrow. [_**Will you please step up and help us reach our goal? We can’t do this without you.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87900428/482639021/-908165598?&refcode=E9311-20240629-DecisionKicker-SL-DeadlineEOQ&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiM2MxMjhiZDUtN2MzNi1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=tRfPz_INpujU_leniFm4FtXzpdznZOTupRnJihTi_cc=)
More from Josh below about why this is so important!
\- Ryan Feldman
Campaign Manager, Josh Harder

**— FORWARDED MESSAGE—**

Peter —
I had to make a tough decision today.
We had a meeting where we had to decide what our budget should be for digital ads this summer. A brand new poll showed us down by 1 point, so we know that we have to start reaching voters ASAP.
While I’d like to green-light the budget, I’m nervous because we’re so far off from our big end-of-quarter fundraising goal.
**So, I had to make a difficult call:** Should I move forward with a new investment in digital ads or wait to see if we hit our fundraising deadline goal?
Ultimately, I decided we should remain dark on ads and wait until we hit our fundraising goal. I hate this because it gives Republicans the upper hand. BUT if we see a surge in donations we can reach our goal and I’ll be able to give my team the green light ASAP.
Will you step up here, Peter? I really want to get these ads up, but I need your help. I’m dropping a custom ActBlue link below so I can track all our supporters who help us meet this goal.
[_**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/JHCA-09-Email-June2024-FR-EOQ? &refcode2=Peter**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87900429/482639022/-908165598?&refcode=E9311-20240629-DecisionKicker-SL-DeadlineEOQ&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiM2MxMjhiZDUtN2MzNi1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=tRfPz_INpujU_leniFm4FtXzpdznZOTupRnJihTi_cc=)
Appreciate you going on this journey with us,
— Josh

Manteca, CA 95337
United States

Thank you for having my back when we fought for **health care coverage for 9/11 first responders** and **expanded benefits for veterans** exposed to toxic burn pits. We must ensure that our heroes get the care that they need.
Thank you for supporting my hard-won legislation that **empowers survivors of sexual assault** in the military to seek justice. Together, we took on the Pentagon to win reforms that will create a fairer system for service members.
Thank you for never giving up the fight to **make gun trafficking a federal crime.** After 14 years of advocacy, late nights and whipping votes, my legislation was finally passed in the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act. Already, we're stopping the flow of illegal guns into New York.
Thank you for your continued commitment to family rights and gender equity. With your support, I have spent the last decade fighting for **national paid family leave** for all workers. And now, I'm proud to lead the charge to add the **Equal Rights Amendment** to our Constitution — which would finally give us the legal basis to restore reproductive rights across the country.
**My record is about winning real results for the families I swore to serve — not for corporations or megadonors. And none of that would be possible without your continued, tireless support.**
But here's the bad news: Republicans are emboldened after their historic victories in New York in 2022. **Now, they're laying the groundwork for an even bigger red wave in 2024 — and they're directly targeting my seat.** I refuse to accept a single cent from corporate PACs, so I'm relying on grassroots donors like you to compete with their right-wing megadonors.

Here is the truth, and you deserve to know it: The Trump campaign and the Republican National Committee recently filed an FEC report showing they out-raised us by a significant amount of money last month... much of the money coming in the days after Trump's guilty verdict. Because not only will that money be used to attack President Biden, but to elect MAGA candidates running against Democrats in races up and down the ballot. No one person could donate the amount we came up short. The ONLY chance we have is if lots and lots of Democrats who understand the importance of this moment step up to help us close the gap. Remember: the results of the last four presidential elections show there are more of us than there are of them. And if we all do our part in this moment, we're going to win again this November. clean_body: Sent in support of Katrina Christiansen for North Dakota and Lucas Kunce for Missouri Peter, I’m running to replace Kevin Cramer in the Senate and fight for working and middle-class Americans because I know what it’s like to struggle. I don’t come from money, Peter. I grew up in a family that struggled to get by in rural America. We counted on food stamps to put dinner on the table. We counted on government-funded programs, like Headstart for Preschool. So believe me when I say I know what it’s like to struggle. I know what it’s like to wonder where your next meal is coming from. I know what it’s like to live on a fixed income. But I’m up against Republican Kevin Cramer who has only voted to slash funding from federal programs struggling families rely on and funnel special interest cash into his campaign coffers. I know this race may seem like an uphill battle, Peter. But until 2018, this seat was a Democratic stronghold for almost six decades. The truth is: This race is one of Democrats’ best chances in the entire country to flip a Senate seat from red to blue – but ONLY if we have the resources to get my message to every undecided voter in the state. name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: I hope you’re aware of this
body:
Just checking in to make sure that you know about...
Hey Pro-Life Friend,

This is an emergency. Breitbart just reported:
[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gydzdk-duchtdja-y/)
**“ABORTION GIANT PLANNED PARENTHOOD WILL DUMP $40 MILLION TO BOOST BIDEN, DEMOCRATS.”**

If we don’t finish this June 30th**End of Quarter** fundraising period strong, I fear for the worst.

The Abortion Lobby wants abortion-on-demand – _throughout all nine months of a pregnancy_ –FORCED on every state in the country and they want taxpayers to pay for it!

Simply put, we **_HAVE_** to stop the Abortion Lobby from seizing total control of Washington, D.C.

But I need to make sure every _Students for Life Action_ supporter is on the same page, so I attached a recent email you might have missed with some important info in it below.

**_It’s important that you read through it if you have the time_!**

Thanks for everything you do, Pro-Life Friend.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_
### [>> DONATE TO STUDENTS FOR LIFE ACTION’S END OF QUARTER PUSH <<](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gydzdk-duchtdja-j/)_\---------- Begin Forwarded Message ----------_

Dear Pro-Life Friend,

I’m forwarding an email I sent you last week because I have a **_HUGE_** update to it!

Last year, a handful of South Carolina Republican State Senators joined with Democrats in stonewalling our _Life at Conception Act,_ which would have abolished abortion in the Palmetto State.

Three were up for reelection this year.

Just two weeks ago – _after Students for Life Action activists knocked on thousands of doors in their districts, handed out hundreds of flyers at churches, and made even more calls, texts, and emails_ – TWO of the three **_LOST_** in their primary elections!

And the third one, Senator Katrina Shealy, was left facing a runoff election that was scheduled for yesterday . . .

**Pro-Life Friend, pro-lifers are now THREE for THREE!**

_. . . And now the Abortion Lobby is panicking!_

In fact, _The Guardian_ is now reporting, _“Complete Abortion Ban in South Carolina More Likely After Primaries.”_

Thanks to the support of good folks like you, we were able to put everything we had into this runoff election to make sure voters in Sen. Shealy’s district know how she stabbed pro-lifers in the back.

And because of these efforts, Sen. Shealy was **trounced** so badly that she wasn’t even able to pick up 40% of the vote!

Hopefully this just proves how big of an impact your support for our work has on Life across the country!

And it sends a strong signal to the leaders of the GOP that this Pro-Life Generation means business when we demand Republicans live up to our pro-life principles.

So, thank you and keep up everything you’re doing for Life – _because it’s working!_

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

[**DONATE TO _STUDENTS FOR LIFE ACTION_ HERE**](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gydzdk-duchtdja-i/) _\-----Begin Forwarded Message-----_

Dear Pro-Life Friend,

You never hear when pro-lifers win from the pro-abortion media.

But thanks to your support, pro-lifers just had some incredible victories during South Carolina’s primary elections yesterday!

Last night, **_TWO_** South Carolina Senate Republicans who betrayed pro-lifers in stonewalling our _Life at Conception Act_ which would have ended abortion in the Palmetto state, just LOST in their primaries.

_And a** _THIRD_** one will face a runoff in two weeks!_

Media elites are FURIOUS!

You see, after a group of South Carolina Republicans joined forces with Planned Parenthood to KILL our _Life at Conception Act in 2023, The New York Times_ did everything they could to paint these traitors as heroes.

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gydzdk-duchtdja-d/)
These Republicans that pro-lifers just beat are among the same “Sister Senators” this headline posted by _The New York Times_ not long ago is referring to.

They’re the same women who our students delivered “Grow a Spine” awards to, asking them to stand up to _Planned Parenthood,_ and who laughed and called us names from the floor of the Senate (here's the photo proof).
[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gydzdk-duchtdja-h/)
But as of last night, one of them, Senator Penry Gustafson, was beaten very badly.

And after _Students for Life Action’s_ field team knocked on 1,134 doors in her district, another one, Senator Sandy Senn, lost by only 31 votes!

With two of these three **_GONE_** – _and pro-lifers gearing to kick the third to the curb as well_ – we’ll have a real chance at finally passing our _Life at Conception Act_ in South Carolina in 2025.

**_So, who’s laughing now?_**

But even after our victories last night, we can’t celebrate just yet . . .

We have to put everything we’ve got into this runoff election to make sure voters in Republican Senator Katrina Shealy’s district know how she’s stabbed pro-life voters and preborn babies in the back.

Pro-Life Friend, these victories are going to help us take some BIG steps forward in our effort to save lives.

And they’ll also show national GOP types who are considering weakening the RNC platform on Life what a disaster that would be for them in their primaries – _and in November!_

**[So, would you please make your most generous contribution of $250, $100, $50, or $25 to _Students for Life Action’s_ election efforts so we can deal the final blow to the Abortion Lobby in South Carolina](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gydzdk-duchtdja-k/)?**

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: Can I get your thoughts on religious liberty in America?
body:
After the Respect for Marriage Act was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law

|
---
| | | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z171hvf390jchgo7mj6iaad3pq1j145smfs1dk28_rp22sh2s8i6ep34stgmapj2chh2bs)
---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z1t2atdftfctmaie5efbumf8tijpfd40mapl7bmo_rp22sh2s8i6ep34stgmapj2chh2bs) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z060pqbunmkm18ntcadivl431clrcogbu1hd3038_rp22sh2s8i6ep34stgmapj2chh2bs)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zlhg4iiv5460l6r475mnqtmjm80dp04aj62mls1o_rp22sh2s8i6ep34stgmapj2chh2bs)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

name: Jim Carris
subject: Today's Incident in Highland Park
body:
Peter,Earlier today, the city of Highland Park issued a community advisory involving an incident that occurred in the early hours of Saturday morning where "protestors carried banners and shouted pro-Palestinian and antisemitic chants using loudspeakers and drums" in [the vicinity of Congressman Brad Schndeider's home](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ekjdkjd-tlidtddjku-r/). I stand with Brad Schneider, his family, and all neighbors of Highland Park and the 10th District who value peace and tranquility in our communities. It is simply appalling that Congressman Schneider and his family would have demonstrators approach their home at 3 o'clock in the morning on any day, let alone on the Jewish Sabbath. While Congressman Schneider and I disagree on many issues, we both agree that there is no place for this type of behavior from any organization at any time when opportunities exist for constructive dialogue. No neighborhood in Highland Park nor any community with Jewish residents in our District should be subject to antisemitism of any kind and I condemn all acts of hate towards them. Jim Carris
Candidate for Congress [](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ekjdkjd-tlidtddjku-y/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ekjdkjd-tlidtddjku-j/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ekjdkjd-tlidtddjku-t/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ekjdkjd-tlidtddjku-i/) [ Share ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-fb-ekjdkjd-tlidtddjku-d/) [ Tweet ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-tw-ekjdkjd-tlidtddjku-h/) [ Share ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-li-ekjdkjd-tlidtddjku-k/) [ Forward ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.forwardtomyfriend.com/t-tlidtddjku-FE53F914-ekjdkjd-l-u) | [Unsubscribe](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-u-ekjdkjd-tlidtddjku-x/)

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: What are your thoughts?
body:
After the Respect for Marriage Act was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law

|
---
| | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2znou0mg57295h9k9ort5qv2f7e3parl8b8j85f1g_rp22sh2s8i6ep34stgm1o77c1h2bs)
---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zv2e7h0pasec77cnq2q5sn2rk9ctekfr7hn6huh8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34stgm1o77c1h2bs) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zupeve87f2j50b2ddh09n8gr5710r2c7lh4k65i8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34stgm1o77c1h2bs)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2ziqe55tu2ueqqn7rcpvvqb47916o1puqk7lhu750_rp22sh2s8i6ep34stgm1o77c1h2bs)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: Can I get your thoughts on religious liberty in America?
body:
After the Respect for Marriage Act was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law

|
---
| | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zfdk0iflfgqkt3mguepfc7nuq3v5b1r39r9pgp0o_rp22sh2s8i6ep34stim4ob6c9h2bs)
---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zm5vp1sgnj7166cmmnpmgv70bigmekkddtmfs5jo_rp22sh2s8i6ep34stim4ob6c9h2bs) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zkf9m9ptm1lq3r5ktutnpj8ktgjo6l2s30ot56fg_rp22sh2s8i6ep34stim4ob6c9h2bs)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z8ug7kkpgi1f7plebp7vji9n96b1uvb2l4rdvq5o_rp22sh2s8i6ep34stim4ob6c9h2bs)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

## Biden Raises $27 Million After Debate Debacle
Since Thursday's [presidential debate](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1uhTAMQOGnCVuQY_4uQ4YubLdrR2QS5-IqEEQiaN--aufOZzjS9_GcnyRR9tc7bWxLSDO5IhfPvW5AYzu3lbeBGbmp2JrBjEPXgcFqtdS4caFxeDzIh2U0j54XB8wDL4GCgUosArbQN2AA0HS1YfRdS_1IDoIbe9UCeynprD-T7GXlEL_TxWft0lZFu5ZyZNW8KZwUTvd91yF97Xzn365wOlKUIi4rnBbxvOuVzlOydrQdJK9du0iyZX2SZPYah01n2R1rzwsVrk7rj1tilNwPqoXXRhL_1uV_iMviTwAAAP__Poli2w), the Biden campaign has [raised $27 million](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L9utDAQBPCnMZ3RegFzFC6-hu6-NiXy2etjI_9B4IDy9hGp0430k2ak-XguT8uR8_u_TWRqKIt1lU9atOxAYr_0jTeBCKlryKhRTeMwgMJmNY9H0H5UEyFYhM4Tdg-vyBOiG1BhwwYBe9AdKABUQ6sI_dBbPVkHwU1a9ECea9nbz8K5rhTidzlpb11JTTRrrdshun8CZ4HzdV2tyy93o8D5rhY4g77zJHB-sacsnU2b5XeW4Sv73fJBh8RRJo6RS5ZbOar09LKV2rWm2OzGb9eNhx5FD-9kOf7O17_POA3-BAAA__86dGAe), part of an effort to match Trump's recent donation momentum and rebound from a lackluster debate performance. The campaign is trying to reassure donors of Biden's viability for the November election, and Democratic figures, including former Presidents Obama and Clinton, are urging voters to look beyond the debate. Others in the party, however, are suggesting Biden should consider [stepping aside for a new candidate](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7GO6yAQRb8Gd7aGMeBQULzGXV67pTWBIZkVCZGN7N2_X3nr7a50pXN0Pq7LlaTI6_6fnhxargvFJjsvrh-hR7OYLoXMjDx2HPSk_WQtaOweQZOP7qLBss1kXM5-ggxgrLMM48V2EhDQgBtBA6C2g2ZM1pDzFCFH75QBTtLqOnxWebUH5_Jdd16HWJ9dCY_W3psa_ymcFc7HcQz0JXU7X4XzyVY4gzu3VzjfJPGrT3yjxv3K70KRe0q7bLxu3RrS-5BSZHOTMnB_kpRfT_u7eg_4EwAA__-ikleY).
## Alec Baldwin Manslaughter Case Not Dismissed
A judge has [rejected Alec Baldwin's request](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FuhSAUQL8GtmcuF4QyMHRxe107GoSrYlBelEj6983r3O0kJznJ-X6OT59yOpYvv5Orcxl9qOmmUT8kPFCNikc3EyFJTk4YYU3fg0C-Om30NEVrBUbyUXsRego2zsobEyf5wZNDQAVaggBA0XeCMPbKa-sDzMFqpoBiquXstpKOutKcf8pNZxfKzrNba31dTH4yHBgOrbVumsLbMRwOahfDwZ81hUxvDHJZpI6bhq3w08VXSzmnSxumYNl9yn_V-v_j7fA3AAD__-zRU30) to dismiss the involuntary manslaughter charge against him for the fatal shooting of Halyna Hutchins on the set of the film "Rust," with the trial set to begin on July 9. Baldwin, who was holding the prop gun that [discharged and killed Hutchins](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGvozAQhH-N6TayFzAvhYtr6N61V0b7zBo2MnZkm0T8-xNXXzeakb7RzJ_vxzdJlLT-pp1dC_lBvsmbHxZ6DTg8hm5xgRm579iZydyncdQGu839hMnbcTQ99uarR2P5q_doiayeBvLciUONg7a9NlqjGW-GcRkHsnfyOvi7VYPmRVout2eW1DYO8cxvLjef9y66rbVXVf0vhbPCOZ2vXNsVKZwvsMJZ20vfFc5HhcSfqnCmyB5-KC4fSdAyBPIMkt45HqlROWGnVCMd69a4QCtCESTB84gnULi857GsDIWf7FuF_YhNXpGBQ8il1Yu5SN2lVvAblZWv1q645fWRGKXaSQ163Univx3t_6--Hf4NAAD__3LxfAU), has consistently claimed he did not pull the trigger and is unaware of how live ammunition was present on set. The film's armorer, Hannah Gutierrez-Reed, has already been sentenced to 18 months for the same charge. Baldwin's defense faced a setback when the firearm in question was [destroyed during an FBI forensic test](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQAL8Gd1iAMUkKite4y2uvtDbs2uwJQ2SIrfz9KVdfN9I0o_m6z3fgxHn9Dxv5tpQZQuODZicHJY2dbYd-ITI0dOT1Rd8u46i06aLXFh1q5YYloHYLuasGDHS9DoABrOvYG2WscoPSShk99poMjhbcDYJaws0Jqwi5lb3_LpxbpCW9y0F7H8rWJR9be1Yx_BNmEmY6z7MPj5rprB8vzPRBYSZIFOQDEp6cZYT0ziDjq4XIucr9VZussZTGeZVtZ0hyebBE2GAllOsrS6Ta9vImlHQwUg4kzNTtHp8np8TVXYRV6wacfsPa35sOb34CAAD__04lbcw), which his lawyers argued should lead to his exoneration.
## List: The Cost of Living Comfortably
A new study shows the the amount of income it takes to live [comfortably in every U.S. state,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FuwyAQxvGnsTciODAxA0OXbOna0bqaI7kKhwiurvL2lTt3_g3f9_-4Llfkwo_bO24UJdcFV-GdFq-sVuAWN6aYiYDsSNGcTThPkzYw3iM4G7RLlNEHmMFqmlwwyaY8h9n5eeQIGpz2VhutwUwnQ5Amhz7gqvMa_OA0JZbaTl-VH3KnXF51p3Za6zaWeBd59sG-DXAZ4NI3bIK9kxw8wCWhoOrynZj64YJCqmPB9lKFd37c1Fq3XJvgZ3mp48vYYnr-cCnc_Xlw-rYhl781-b99j_AbAAD__7T-XCY) ranking Massachusetts as the most expensive at $116,000 and West Virginia the least, at $78,790. The research applied the 50/30/20 rule for a "comfortable" lifestyle: 50% of income for basic needs like food and housing, 30% on things you want, and 20% for savings. The study offers the income needed for a single working adult, as well as the amount needed for a family to live comfortably. North Carolina sits right in the middle, with an $89,000 salary needed for a single adult and $209,000 needed for a family. subject: What are your thoughts?
body:
After the Respect for Marriage Act was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law

|
---
| | | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=41ec03c71c1b41d4becab404faff5e25&_e=APTCZEFwoZUEatVUN28yJN5TPc57b7O0AS1wUwU5Lvcm4LUGspUn86WD264DygBFkIE1lonTyws9vm0vIh4TsRnb95pvf3TlNQHV2m6qofSjuAfwvd03oULY3zPtLQorq7X-FDB5c5I0NyDBpPdQ-nyTh5yM3ilSjb6OsbXo94iA1xnxGAjHCekQTyT9PO3Vxii1FujBylUbSzMLNZRSNZ9MdUQZsr_48H07ITI5Td-pAHbe_J7PPeyfVjCxcx6xnUEB4eLmltFQ4ObYY0h6XP5XjwBdLhreENiLQNFQGhrWnUyr8XXaPhEUMC0LDKbHWr7muikGZv_8y-BAuHBb9risnCLudwsVnUnXdh8F04sJz4Syf2rNBAiKCbkEjJOcdvWnBbwfPbrTkEt4HoMOdtvp8qL6jNILz0FrGBSrp4M%3D)
---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=41ec03c71c1b41d4becab404faff5e25&_e=APTCZEFwoZUEatVUN28yJN5TPc57b7O0AS1wUwU5Lvcm4LUGspUn86WD264DygBFkIE1lonTyws9vm0vIh4TsRnb95pvf3TlNQHV2m6qofSjuAfwvd03oULY3zPtLQorq7X-FDB5c5I0NyDBpPdQ-nyTh5yM3ilSjb6OsbXo94iA1xnxGAjHCekQTyT9PO3Vxii1FujBylUbSzMLNZRSNZ9MdUQZsr_48H07ITI5Td-pAHbe_J7PPeyfVjCxcx6xnUEB4eLmltFQ4ObYY0h6XAZfxY6uZyEfTPK4fIIN5mo-rmAjSBLTil5WzE1FXXrr3SAxS9fELerFwRQ6uEac11Jh0ZNW2fYBCW0BApKIzrrZeMAyfkqUowD9wIcghskn2_LPgA07zRKbgG-PvQlG0qozzp_eLwQrUfg5JbIl7BI%3D) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=41ec03c71c1b41d4becab404faff5e25&_e=APTCZEFwoZUEatVUN28yJN5TPc57b7O0AS1wUwU5Lvcm4LUGspUn86WD264DygBFkIE1lonTyws9vm0vIh4TsRnb95pvf3TlNQHV2m6qofSjuAfwvd03oULY3zPtLQorq7X-FDB5c5I0NyDBpPdQ-nyTh5yM3ilSjb6OsbXo94iA1xnxGAjHCekQTyT9PO3Vxii1FujBylUbSzMLNZRSNZ9MdUQZsr_48H07ITI5Td-pAHbe_J7PPeyfVjCxcx6xnUEB4eLmltFQ4ObYY0h6XMpB5OHs-J5vs7U1SDH6kpU-VrJHAlePGsEAfSUkiOv_E5KQK2HiIghGPq2GGybsnt61ZAoXoF42SDb2JJSOrR4Rau4xjQBVW5QDiaDYCecWtNPPTa51WtwlrIQKNQIxKtqFNw_sQlKjDLdc1qxoWJ8%3D)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=41ec03c71c1b41d4becab404faff5e25&_e=APTCZEFwoZUEatVUN28yJN5TPc57b7O0AS1wUwU5Lvcm4LUGspUn86WD264DygBFkIE1lonTyws9vm0vIh4TsRnb95pvf3TlNQHV2m6qofSjuAfwvd03oULY3zPtLQorq7X-FDB5c5I0NyDBpPdQ-nyTh5yM3ilSjb6OsbXo94iA1xnxGAjHCekQTyT9PO3Vxii1FujBylUbSzMLNZRSNZ9MdUQZsr_48H07ITI5Td-pAHbe_J7PPeyfVjCxcx6xnUEB4eLmltFQ4ObYY0h6XLVoAOkPZ8nY2FCq_17Oq_rh6RPtMaGX8M37bsRH86wyEEwfEo75O1KyzxBkjdYiWXmJAPqEFe1psYiwxLwO3G9ijduL5zfmDG9V-A5UWno_omtSORshDfYKpSALQddBky_U_clFRzeLjX8x5QTxKFE%3D)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

Hey Peter, it's Jon Hamm.
#
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54378?refcode=em20240630-5884&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5884%2E614464%2EGsKra3)
Hey Peter, it’s Jon Hamm.
**There’s an important U.S. Senate race happening in my home state this year that I think you need to know about.**
So before I ask you to chip in toward my friend Lucas Kunce’s campaign to defeat Josh Hawley and flip Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat, please let me explain why no one can afford to sit on the sidelines in this race.
**[DEFEAT JOSH HAWLEY](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54378?refcode=em20240630-5884&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5884%2E614464%2EGsKra3)**
Let’s start at the beginning. When I first got to know Lucas, his story resonated with me. He’s a born-and-raised Missourian who knows the real value of community — helping each other out, for better or for worse.
Growing up, his parents went bankrupt from his youngest sister’s medical bills and his family survived on the support of their friends and neighbors. After getting to college on a Pell Grant, Lucas decided to join the U.S. Marine Corps to honor the community that had given his family so much. He served for 13 years, including three deployments to Iraq and Afghanistan before later being stationed at the Pentagon.
Once he left active duty, Lucas turned his focus to the corrupt politicians and corporate monopolies that dominate our economy and squeeze small businesses. He took on everyone from Big Tech and Big Ag to defense contractors and pharmaceutical companies.
**Now, Lucas is running to defeat January 6th coward Josh Hawley and take back Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat for real, everyday people.**
**[ELECT LUCAS KUNCE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54378?refcode=em20240630-5884&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=5884%2E614464%2EGsKra3)**
Let’s just be clear here: Hawley’s January 6th cowardice isn’t the only reason he’s incapable of representing my home state.
**Since he was elected to office, Josh Hawley hasn’t fought to bring even $0.01 back to our communities — but he’s had plenty of time to make money for himself.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54378?refcode=em20240630-5884&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=5884%2E614464%2EGsKra3)
While giant corporations strip our state of opportunity and jack up prices, Hawley is only focused on enriching himself. He’s made hundreds of thousands of dollars more than his congressional salary by selling his weird book all about _"Manhood."_
**All this, while he made taxpayers cover the cost of his own lawbreaking.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54378?refcode=em20240630-5884&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=5884%2E614464%2EGsKra3)
Missouri can’t afford another six years of Hawley in the Senate, Peter, and voters of all stripes seem to agree.
**_Morning Consult_ reported that Josh Hawley has the lowest approval rating of any Republican incumbent up for re-election this November.** And even Hawley’s own former mentor, Missouri’s three-term Republican U.S. Senator Jack Danforth, said supporting Hawley was _“the worst decision I’ve ever made in my life.”_
After spending a whole year consolidating support from workers, community leaders, and organizations across Missouri, Lucas Kunce has more than proved that he has what it takes to win this race. Multiple polls even confirm he’s in a dead heat with Hawley. That’s why I’m asking for your help, Peter:
**[Will you join me in supporting my friend Lucas Kunce by chipping in $10 or more today? With so much at stake in this election — and with a race this close — no one can afford to sit on the sidelines.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54378?refcode=em20240630-5884&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=5884%2E614464%2EGsKra3)**

[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54379?refcode=em20240630-5884&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=7&akid=5884%2E614464%2EGsKra3) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54379?refcode=em20240630-5884&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=8&akid=5884%2E614464%2EGsKra3) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54378?refcode=em20240630-5884&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=9&akid=5884%2E614464%2EGsKra3)

Lucas won’t be another shady, corrupt politician. He’s put his money where his mouth is since day one — refusing to accept any money from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, or Big Oil and Big Pharma executives.
**He’s running to be a real warrior for working Missourians, unbeholden to anyone other than the everyday people who elected him to office.**
Lucas will fight for investment in our state — rebuilding forgotten communities, creating jobs, and empowering workers. He’ll stand up to the attacks on reproductive rights by controlling politicians like Hawley. He’ll work to end the corporate grip on power in our country, by banning insider trading and abolishing corporate PACs. And he’ll be accountable to real, everyday Missourians.
I can’t tell you how excited I am about everything we’ll be able to accomplish in Missouri with Lucas fighting for us in the Senate, Peter. But if we’re going to take advantage of this historic opportunity, Lucas urgently needs your help.

Welcome to the United College Park community!

We are thrilled to have you join us in shaping a brighter future for
College Park, GA. Your commitment to staying informed and engaged is a
vital part of our collective effort to bring about positive change and
unity within our community.

WHAT TO EXPECT

As a subscriber, you will receive timely updates on essential news,
action alerts, and upcoming events directly via email. Our goal is to
keep you involved and informed about the key movements and initiatives
that impact our beloved community.

GET INVOLVED

There are numerous ways to make your voice heard and contribute to our
efforts:

### **1.[Nonprofit pushing climate-change lawsuits making outreach to Delco, Chester counties, email shows](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=46567ba95a&e=b7b3eddce2)**
_By Todd Shepherd_
The nonprofit trying to persuade local governments to sue “Big Oil” producers for damages allegedly caused by climate change has been making steady advances to Chester and Delaware counties, according to an email provided to _Broad + Liberty_. The revelation comes just two months after the Bucks County Board of Commissioners[ announced](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=4bc74ecb0e&e=b7b3eddce2) it would sue major oil producers like BP, Chevron, Exxon, and others, arguing that the companies knew for decades that their products would cause climate change yet took no action. Several days after the announcement, the only Republican on the three-person board, Gene DiGirolamo, withdrew his support for the suit. Indeed, it appears as if the Center for Climate Integrity (CCI) was eager to use its success with Bucks County as a springboard.
**Why It Matters.** Some of the initial lawsuits against Big Oil have already failed. In 2019, a New York judge ruled in Exxon’s favor, but as is often the case, the message of the ruling was nuanced, with Justice Barry Ostrager of the New York State Supreme Court writing, “this is a securities fraud case, not a climate change case.” Other cases remain in progress, and, “[t]he number of climate-related cases against Exxon continues to grow,” the[ Wall Street Journal recently reported](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=81e4e13a37&e=b7b3eddce2). IRS filings show CCI is predominantly funded by the Rockefeller Family Fund, the philanthropic endeavor established by the legendary New York family whose business pursuits in the earliest parts of the 20th century produced Standard Oil, the petroleum monopoly whose most prominent corporate successor is Exxon. The Journal also reported that the Rockefeller Family Fund “influenced President Biden’s decision in January to pause approval of new liquefied natural gas exports,” — a decision that touched off bipartisan condemnations in Pennsylvania, the nation’s largest LNG exporter.
**Quotable**. “I agree that it’s not fair for this burden of addressing climate change to fall only on our residents,” Delaware County Council Chair Monica Taylor[ said](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=82609089b9&e=b7b3eddce2). “Polluters should and must pay.”

### **2.[Republicans learned the wrong lesson from Tuesday’s primaries](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=f1663de468&e=b7b3eddce2)**

_By Seth Higgins_
Given the[ cheering](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=ad0e05cadb&e=b7b3eddce2) coming from[ various corners](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=e4bb587a4a&e=b7b3eddce2) of the right, it would seem as though Republicans emerged triumphant from Tuesday’s primaries in New York and Colorado. However, that would be mistaken. Yes, Representative Jamaal Bowman, member of the House of Representatives’ progressive squad, lost his primary in a district on the outskirts of New York City. This is a cause for celebration. But the celebration should be coming from the center-left, because they, not conservatives, ejected a caustic member of their coalition in a closed primary. Republicans played little, if any, part in Bowman’s defeat. Meanwhile, Republican voters in Colorado’s fourth Congressional District walked into voting booths on Tuesday, said “[Beetlejuice](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=1632ee7a6f&e=b7b3eddce2)” three times, and in doing so[ conjured Lauren Boebert another term](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=91c4c2cdc2&e=b7b3eddce2) in the House, where she’ll spend the next two years tormenting the few remaining conservatives capable of experiencing embarrassment. **Why It Matters. **All too often, Republicans nominate candidates that appeal to the conservative id only to have them crash and burn in the general election. Simultaneously, Republicans have seldom sent their clowns back to the circus. Boebert’s survival is just the latest example. All the pie-throwing and car-horn-honking going on in the House is causing some of the Republican Party’s most[ talented members to call it quits](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=86667202e5&e=b7b3eddce2) on electoral politics. This trend costs Republicans dearly. For example, the inability of Republican primary voters to distinguish between political substance and satisfaction caused Republicans to miss out on[ securing a Senate majority](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=69be6c0d21&e=b7b3eddce2) in 2010, 2012, and 2022. It is also why Republicans ended up with a[ paper-thin majority](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=e69005f908&e=b7b3eddce2) in the House after the last midterms.

Bari Weiss of the _Free Press_ summed it up best, perhaps, noting that [the debate exposed the lie](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=4c47060aa8&e=b7b3eddce2) that the Biden administration has been pushing non-stop since he took office. clean_body: News + editorial to start your week | Broad + Liberty Weekly Reads | | | | | | | Good morning and welcome to Broad + Liberty 's Weekly Reads. and get the best of Broad + Liberty delivered straight to your inbox. | | 1. By Todd Shepherd The nonprofit trying to persuade local governments to sue “Big Oil” producers for damages allegedly caused by climate change has been making steady advances to Chester and Delaware counties, according to an email provided to Broad + Liberty. The revelation comes just two months after the Bucks County Board of Commissioners it would sue major oil producers like BP, Chevron, Exxon, and others, arguing that the companies knew for decades that their products would cause climate change yet took no action. Several days after the announcement, the only Republican on the three-person board, Gene DiGirolamo, withdrew his support for the suit. Indeed, it appears as if the Center for Climate Integrity (CCI) was eager to use its success with Bucks County as a springboard. Why It Matters. Some of the initial lawsuits against Big Oil have already failed. In 2019, a New York judge ruled in Exxon’s favor, but as is often the case, the message of the ruling was nuanced, with Justice Barry Ostrager of the New York State Supreme Court writing, “this is a securities fraud case, not a climate change case.” Other cases remain in progress, and, “[t]he number of climate-related cases against Exxon continues to grow,” the. IRS filings show CCI is predominantly funded by the Rockefeller Family Fund, the philanthropic endeavor established by the legendary New York family whose business pursuits in the earliest parts of the 20th century produced Standard Oil, the petroleum monopoly whose most prominent corporate successor is Exxon. The Journal also reported that the Rockefeller Family Fund “influenced President Biden’s decision in January to pause approval of new liquefied natural gas exports,” — a decision that touched off bipartisan condemnations in Pennsylvania, the nation’s largest LNG exporter. Quotable. “I agree that it’s not fair for this burden of addressing climate change to fall only on our residents,” Delaware County Council Chair Monica Taylor. “Polluters should and must pay.” | | 2. By Seth Higgins Given the coming from of the right, it would seem as though Republicans emerged triumphant from Tuesday’s primaries in New York and Colorado. However, that would be mistaken. Yes, Representative Jamaal Bowman, member of the House of Representatives’ progressive squad, lost his primary in a district on the outskirts of New York City. This is a cause for celebration. As followers of Jesus, we are all compelled to address a critical
need that exists across the globe:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osBqLYmWNj

Dear
Friend,

As
followers of Jesus, we are all compelled to address a critical
need that exists across the globe: Billions of people wake up
each day without the comfort and guidance of the Word of God in
their native language.

In some
regions, entire communities have yet to receive a single verse of
scripture, while others face a severe shortage of Bibles.

I'm
reaching out to you because we believe that together, we can make
a profound impact on the lives of those who are yearning for the
transformative power of the gospel.

Will you
provide Bibles to people groups who have yet to hear God's Word
with a gift today?

Our
commitment to providing Bibles and Scripture portions to people
and communities worldwide is unwavering. However, we recognize
that we cannot do this alone. We need your help to ensure that
the gospel reaches every corner of the world.

When you
give today, you will:

Not
only pass a Bible along but potentially change lives eternally.
Help
support over 3,500 IMB missionaries on the ground, teaching the
Bible and bringing hope to spiritually lost communities.

Answer God's call to share His Word with those who have yet to
hear it.

You can
click on the secure link below to make a donation of any amount
and bring the transformative power of the gospel to those who
need it the most.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63342630:sBqLYmWNj:m:3:2532013465:65C252DDDCC76069A66E0A8F2540AFDD:r

Your
support is more than a financial contribution; it's a beacon of
hope, a lifeline to those who have yet to experience the love and
salvation found in Jesus Christ.

Thank you
for considering this urgent call to action. Together, we can make
a difference in the lives of countless individuals and
communities worldwide.

In faith,

Angie
Shepherd

Journeyman Alumni
Prayer
and Missions Advocate

subject: Donald Trump showed us who he is on Thursday. We have to believe him.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Biden for President
body:
On Thursday, I spent 90 minutes debating on a stage with a guy who has all the morals of an alley cat. | | |
---
On Thursday, I spent 90 minutes debating on a stage with a guy who has all the morals of an alley cat. I mean, did you see Donald Trump? _He must have set a new record for the number of lies ever told in a single debate._ He lied about what a great economy he created, when we all remember the pandemic. He lied about how great he was for veterans, when we can recall how he called veterans who had given their lives for this country “suckers” and “losers.” **And he even lied about how he had nothing to do with January 6th.** **But we all saw it _with our own eyes_. _We saw the mob attack the Capitol. We saw the police being attacked. The Capitol ransacked._** Folks, for all of Trump’s lies on Thursday, we did learn some important truths. _We learned he is still proud of being the person who killed Roe v. Wade.
We learned that he wants another giant tax cut for the very wealthy and biggest corporations.
And that he’ll cut your Medicare, your Social Security, and cut your health care to pay for it.
_Most dangerously -- though -- we learned again that Donald Trump will not respect the outcome of this year’s election.__ Donald Trump showed us who he is on Thursday. We have to believe him. subject: I am not done.

body:
Our democracy is under threat. Arizona is the front line of that fight. And I am going to do everything I can to make sure that pro-democracy candidates succeed — not only in my home state, but across the country.
#

Friends, it’s Mark.
It wouldn’t surprise me if some of you thought we’d take a break after our campaign in 2020.
Instead, we jumped right back into campaigning for a full term in the U.S. Senate in 2022.
We won in 2020. We won again in 2022. And going into 2024, we are not taking any time off.
Let me make this perfectly clear: I am not done. Not by a long shot.
Our democracy is under threat. Arizona is the front line of that fight. And I am going to do everything I can to make sure that pro-democracy candidates succeed — not only in my home state, but across the country.
I’m going to fight like hell to win this November.
In just a few hours we’re going to hit an important FEC deadline — one of the last before Election Day. What we raise ahead of this deadline is going to determine what we can do to take back the House, hold the Senate, and defeat Trump.
A whole lot of people are going to be watching. Let’s show them what we can do.

Hey Derek, it’s Adam Schiff.
I had to reach out one last time ahead of my campaign’s FEC deadline at midnight tonight.
After it’s over, my team will compile all of our contributions from the past three months, down to the dollar, and file it in a public report with the Federal Election Commission.

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: Reaching out to you personally
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
While I was having breakfast this morning, I found myself thinking of the GIFFORDS community
#

[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-june24.gd3XnS&refcode=em240630-1-30&t=1&akid=8406%2E3935704%2EBgvEQs)
---
Hi there, it's Gabby Giffords.
While I was having breakfast this morning, I found myself thinking of the GIFFORDS community and wanted to reach out to you personally.
Thirteen years ago, I was shot in the head while meeting with constituents in Tucson, Arizona. I’ve been in recovery every single day since then. I often think about my recovery the same way I think about our movement to end gun violence: some days are more difficult than others.
It hasn’t been an easy journey for me, but even on my darkest days, I’ve refused to give up hope. Today, I encourage you to take a moment to renew your hope that we can and will have a future someday where the threat of gun violence no longer looms over us.
**I know this work isn’t easy. But the fights worth having rarely are. That’s why we can never, ever give up.**
Today is a very important day for GIFFORDS PAC. At midnight tonight, we will close the books on our June FEC fundraising deadline. After this deadline, our fundraising numbers will be reported publicly. We need to be sure we have a strong showing in this report with both the amount we raise and the number of individual contributions we receive.
I know that our gun safety movement is stronger than ever before. Now is our chance to prove it to our gun lobby adversaries who say otherwise.
[**So please, can I ask you to chip in $3 to GIFFORDS PAC today? Your support will make a world of difference in reaching our end-of-quarter goals.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-june24.gd3XnS&refcode=em240630-1-30&t=2&akid=8406%2E3935704%2EBgvEQs)

Peter —

This is a more personal message than you generally receive from a campaign, but I wanted to pull back the curtain a bit why I’m in this race, and what the result will mean for our country.

The last few years have been grueling for our nation and our democracy, but it hasn’t always been like this.

There was a time before Donald Trump. When you could disagree without being disagreeable. When it wasn’t taboo to have friends across the aisle, or at least people you could work with. When you would bring people together — Democrats and Republicans — to get things done.

Why? Because it was in the best interest of the American people to have a government that functioned. And that wasn’t in chaos 24/7.

Those days feel long gone now. We have seen a seismic shift in the last few years — since a charlatan celebrity and reality TV host who called disabled veterans “suckers” and “losers,” denigrated our immigrant communities, and railed on about “fake news” was elected President of the United States.

I’ve never been one to back down from the bad guys — so amidst these attacks, I did my duty and called him out. I took on these fights not because they were easy, but because it needed to be done.

That vitriol has taken a turn for the worse. Here’s what the other side has had to say about me:
“Wild-eyed conspiracy nut.” - Tucker Carlson
“Pencil neck. Shifty Schiff.” - Donald Trump
“[He] openly lied to the American public.” - Kevin McCarthy

**Never in my life would I expect to be cast as a president's “favorite” enemy — but here we are. And I’m not going to back down.**

It doesn’t end with these personal attacks either. With every new insult comes a horde of MAGA supporters, ready to pile on more death threats. Through Twitter. Email. Phone calls. Letters. You name it. With multiple people prosecuted for threatening to kill me. That NEVER happened before Trump.

There are days when the fight gets difficult. During the impeachment process. Serving on the January 6 Committee. When House Republicans censured me for doing my constitutional duty.

**But like I said on the House floor, [I am honored by their enmity. I am flattered by the falsehoods they level against me. Those who were the authors of the big lie must attack the truth tellers and I am proud to stand accused. I wear their attacks as a badge of honor. Knowing that I have lived by my oath of office.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87921767/482697935/-1329613398?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240630_1_1&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImUxZDNiYjRmLWVjMzYtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Zi0b1GlGd3xfUfIobgbF_85QWogmeqyeU-uEswy2Zvg=)**

My guiding principle has been serving in a way that will bring pride to my children. I believe that right and truth and decency matter now more than ever.

After long nights of consideration, I decided to run for California’s U.S. Senate seat. Because MAGA Republicans aren’t getting the job done and there’s too much that needs fixing. With everything happening in Florida, it’s critical that school boards are made up of people who aren’t afraid to stand up to MAGA influences.

According to the American Library Association, **book bans have increased 65% in 2023** compared to the year prior — the highest levels ever documented. As CNN has reported, in the first half of the 2023-2024 school year, **“Florida had the highest number of bans compared to other states.”**
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87925214/482708663/94304345?refcode=EM_F_240630EOQ_N_EH_90DO_9_NG_N_P1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImMxYzc3NjdiLWYxMzYtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=GiIzs9wqEqLua_fTlaZ4QQ6Up_HIKQ8-K_m7o-VrbFw=)
---
And that’s not all. This school district is also experiencing a heartbreaking removal of pride flags, a prolonged shortage of teachers and staff, poor salaries, and diminishing quality of education for children. Seminole County recently **experienced a loss of $1.3 million dollars** from the teacher salary budget due to a phishing scam.

Beyond tackling these problems, Stephanie is passionate about advocating for menstrual education and increased access to the necessary products to ensure healthy menstruation management for all students and teachers. With over half of the student and teacher population being female, she is committed to advocating to reduce the impact of period poverty.

[**By electing women like Stephanie into local offices, we will ensure our students, communities, and environment will prosper. Can you help elect Stephanie by pitching in a split $20.24 or more before midnight? →**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hbmfl_arguello/?refcode=EM_F_240630EOQ_N_EH_90DO_9_NG_N_L2&amount=20.24)

In solidarity,

Erica Henry
Political Adviser

AIPAC represents the biggest source of Republican money going into Democratic elections, undermining our democracy. And it’s not just AIPAC. So far, 50 U.S. billionaires have spent more than $600 million to influence our 2024 elections and take down our progressive movement.
**But we won’t back down or be silenced. We will continue demanding the U.S. government divest from genocide and instead invest in our communities’ needs, like healthcare and housing.**

#
Tonight is our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline.
Based on what we raise tonight, we’ll decide where we can afford to do our registration and outreach work in Texas.
The more we raise, the more communities we can work in and the more new Democratic voters we can add to the voting rolls.
**With everything at stake in Texas right now, it’s crucial that Powered by People meets our $250,000 end-of-quarter fundraising goal by the end of today.**
**[DONATE $3](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240630.Et8ciD&refcode=ema20240630-239675&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=19&akid=239675%2E444211%2EqbZQN_)**
Last month, the Texas Republican Party adopted an extreme platform that called for teaching the Bible in public school classrooms, attacking women and the LGBTQ community, as well as denying the winner of the popular vote in Texas the ability to hold office if they don't also win a majority of counties.
This is why your support for Powered by People’s work to organize, register, and mobilize Texas Democrats is so important right now.
[**So please if you can, chip in $3 tonight before midnight to be a part of this fight to win in 2024.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240630.Et8ciD&refcode=ema20240630-239675&t=20&akid=239675%2E444211%2EqbZQN_)

— Beto

body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=38952%2E3422442%2EZhiYNT)
Derek,
As a consumer protection attorney, there’s a lot I’ve always disliked about political emails. I will never send you an email that tries to shame or terrify you into donating. It isn’t my style.
You’ve probably seen emails that say things like:
“We need 5,238 donors from YOUR zip code.” This is fake. We have goals and deadlines, and donations from different parts of the state or country can signal support, but there’s no crazy math like this happening.
“Donate $5 today and it will be triple matched.” I promise nobody is really doing this.
“Warning: Payment incomplete.” I despise these misleading emails that make you think you’ve missed a bill. Invoking this type of fear in people is unacceptable.
I’ve introduced legislation to crackdown on scam PACs, which can often be the worst offenders. Scam PACs are political organizations that exist to steal money rather than to support a cause or candidate. Their expenditures go solely to “consultants” rather than real causes, and it’s a shameful way to make a quick buck.
Here’s what is real: our fundraising deadlines and the facts we give you about the candidates I am supporting. There is urgency, yes, because we’re less than six months away from November and we need to take back the House.
Our end of quarter deadlines are some of the most important, as we have to publicly report how much we raise every three months. But our monthly and even weekly internal goals help us hit those quarterly goals, and as Election Day nears, each week’s fundraising really helps our work.
**[Truly, whatever zip code you’re in, I’d be so appreciative of your support! Can you make a contribution today ahead of our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240630?refcode=em20240630-38952&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38952_3422442_ZhiYNT&akid=38952%2E3422442%2EZhiYNT)**

Thanks for reading, and thanks for supporting Truth to Power today.
Katie

**Katie Porter started Truth to Power to support Democrats who reject corporate PAC money** and are running to protect the environment, restore the nationwide right to an abortion, and create an economy that works for working people. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/truth-to-power-1?refcode=em20240630-38952&amounts=&t=2&refcode2=38952_3422442_ZhiYNT&akid=38952%2E3422442%2EZhiYNT)**

body:

#
]
Peter: As you read this email, Ruben Gallego is getting absolutely clobbered in Arizona.
[**If you can spare $5 today to help him fight back against Kari Lake and Trump, please: Make a donation right away.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-june24.NmHAEe&amount=5&refcode=em240630-2-120&t=1&akid=2555%2E734936%2EQfk3UH)

subject: Midnight Deadline - We are so close.
body:
This fall, we have the opportunity of a lifetime for a Republican victory here in Maryland’s Congressional District #6. I have exciting news. The NRCC | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us2.campaign-archive.com/?e=5a45ee1154&u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=87fc496588)
---
| |
---
| Peter,

Today is the day. I need your help by midnight tonight.

The National Republican Congressional Committee (NRCC) has indicated that **the NRCC will support my race if we have enough financial support by the June 30 th quarterly deadline.** That’s tonight, by midnight.

If you could pitch in $6, $15, $40, $100, $250, or even the maximum $3,300, please do it today. Tonight, by midnight, I need to raise about $12,000. Every single donation helps! We are so close, but still need an additional $12,000 by midnight tonight. Would you help us get this critical support by making an online donation right away?

If I can raise $12,000 by midnight tonight, Sunday, June 30, national groups will help my race.

All over the country, eyes are on our race. This is one of the “WATCH” races for US Congress where they know a Republican can win.

It is an open seat, and our campaign and our values appeal to common-sense people all over our Congressional district.

By making an investment right now for our country, your donation can be multiplied greatly by the NRCC.

Our country is worth the effort, worth the fight, and worth our time. I hope you’ll do what you can to stand with me in this race, at this time.

For our country,

Peter, I may sound like a broken record when I tell you that I’m different from most politicians, but I really mean it.

When it comes to poverty or inequality, food insecurity or housing, mental health or LGBTQ+ rights, I don’t _just_ think about policy — I think about my own experiences. **For me, Peter, policy _is_ personal. It always has been.**

I am a Black, Afro-Latino, LGBTQ+ American. I’m a product of public housing. I don't come from a political family. I am open about my own experiences with depression. I don't have fancy degrees.

Peter, I vow to never give up on these fights so that more folks like me can have a seat at the table — _but I can’t do this alone._

National Republicans have made this race one of their top defensive targets. These insiders know that if they don’t step in to tear down Lucas and make Josh Hawley look strong, there’s a real chance they could lose this Senate seat. So from launching desperate attacks to a new GOP Super PAC, they’ve been hard at work to keep this seat under their thumb. 3. Missouri voters know how to take back their power at the ballot box. In 2018, they rejected anti-union “Right-to-Work” and voted to raise the minimum wage well above the federal level. In 2020, they expanded Medicaid. And in 2022, they legalized weed. So in 2024, they’re ready to defeat Josh Hawley. 4. This November, our race will share a ballot with an initiative to end Missouri’s extreme abortion ban. Red and purple states like Kansas, Kentucky, and Ohio have overwhelmingly passed similar initiatives — and elected pro-freedom candidates like Lucas — when reproductive rights are under attack. So having the resources to get the truth about Hawley’s extreme record on reproductive freedom in front of voters will absolutely make a big difference in this election. 5. Lucas has proved he can harness record-breaking grassroots energy. First, he outraised Hawley over all of 2023. Then, he earned the support of the Missouri AFL-CIO, local and statewide leaders, major national organizations like VoteVets, and tens of thousands of everyday working people. The average donation to elect Lucas is just $28. But now, we’ve got to keep this momentum going. Tonight’s deadline is the next real chance pundits, insiders, and voters will have to assess the strength of our campaign — and we need to continue proving that we’re building the movement that’s going to defeat Josh Hawley and take back power for everyday people. So please: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: Thank you for everything, Team Lucas Kunce | | Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri

Friends,

What happens when you win a primary by 40 points? Morning Joe calls you “Landslide John” - and for good reason. But that’s not all of it.
The energy right now to win this seat and take back the House is palpable. This has been the strongest 72 hours of the campaign so far – and yes, that includes the launch. CBS News just declared that John’s one of the “best hopes of helping Democrats take control of the House.”

Taking back the House from Trump flunkies like Nick LaLota matters more than ever now. If we want to protect abortion rights, it starts in the House. If we want to lower the costs of living and strengthen the middle class by taking on price gougers, it starts in the House.

The change Suffolk County needs – the common sense leadership our country needs – starts in the House.
That’s the fight we’re in. You know John can win. You know John has to win. Because that’s how we take back the House. If you’re with us - we need you to stand with John now. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-donate-general]

It turns out a lot of people are ready to send No-Show Nick LaLota packing. And the funny thing is, Nick knows it. That’s why he was desperately trying to amplify the negative attacks on John in the primary. Now that nothing stands between John and LaLota, he’s already running scared.

Voters want to know the choice they have in front of them, and this race is about showing the contrast between common sense leadership and MAGA extremism. John suggested a series of debates to put that contrast front and center. Of course Nick dodged the debates. You really think he’d actually appear on stage? He’d have to leave the comfort of his keyboard and actually come to the district - where’s he never held an in person town hall as congressman. They call him No-Show Nick for a reason.

Even if Nick’s dodging it - he can’t escape the truth. The first freshman Congressman to endorse Trump in a Biden-held district knows what most of America knows - he’s in deep, deep trouble.
As John said on Tuesday, we win this race by playing offense. We win this race by defining the battlefield on key issues like immigration and the economy. That’s exactly what we’re doing every day.
Now is the time to join Team Avlon. We are pushing hard before our next big campaign deadline - the end of quarter on Sunday night. Can you pitch in before then and make sure we’re ready to take the fight to Nick LaLota? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-donate-general]

Let’s go win back the House.
-Team Avlon

Folks, Listen. I was at the debate the other night. I watched it. I tried to keep track of Trump’s lies as it went on and I ran out of paper. On the substance, Joe Biden won the debate. That is what matters to me. Don’t look at 30 minutes -- Look at the last three-and-a-half years under Joe Biden. It's been a master class: 15.6 million jobs created -- 8x more than the last 3 Republican presidents combined; gun safety legislation; lowering the cost of prescription drugs; an infrastructure package to rebuild this country. Joe Biden has delivered -- and we need to deliver for him in this moment -- for him, and for Democrats everywhere. We're talking about the fate and future of our democracy, this country and the world. They all need us right now. That's what I intend to do, and I hope you'll join me. **I’m so proud that my son Mark is a US Congressman**. It’s hard to believe how far our family has come since our humble beginnings. Let me explain:

I grew up as a Japanese American on the West coast in the 1940s. We faced a lot of xenophobia and racism. And then during World War II, I was illegally detained in racist Japanese American internment camps along with my parents and Mark’s mom. Our family lost everything.

But we persevered. We were freed from the camps and rebuilt our lives in California. And my son has gone on to become a Member of Congress! It’s amazing – _the American Dream in action._

It’s official: this Ohio Senate race is now the most expensive in the country, and it will likely go down as the most expensive in history. We’re in the fight of our lives to flip this seat and reclaim the Republican Senate majority, but Sherrod Brown is leveraging his insider swamp connections to help influence the outcome in his favor. The bad news:this atrocious level of spending is moving the needle for Brown. I mean, just look at these numbers, friend: **Shady Sherrod has reserved a jaw-dropping $104.3 MILLION in ads in total. We’re locked in a dead heat with Brown, but his ability to milk far-left, deep-pocketed donors could be enough to tip the scales in his favor. Everything hinges on what happens in November, and I am determined to make it to Washington to represent you and put America FIRST. Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America. In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board. After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation. Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First. Ohioans are done with politicians who talk a big game and do nothing. Bernie wants to go to D.C. to get work done – just like he always has. Friend,
