Friend,

As we approach the end of the quarter, I want to reach out and
ask if you would consider donating to our campaign to help us reach our goals. [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/soto?refcode=juneEOQ&amount=9]

House Democrats have been building on our progress and working to help create jobs, keep families safe, improve education, and protect civil rights.

We helped secure over $3.5 billion to expand I-4, $1.3 billion to extend Poinciana Parkway, $500 million for microchip manufacturing at NeoCity, and over $200 million for Orlando International Airport. We are now working on a SunRail/Brightline expansion.

We recently passed our FY24 budget, which included funds for Community Projects in Central Florida that focus on pedestrian safety, flood control, clean water, affordable housing, health research, and other initiatives. We secured nearly $14 MILLION for projects in Florida's Ninth Congressional District.

Friend, we're proud of our momentum and are ready to keep going until Election Day. Please support our efforts today. [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/soto?refcode=juneEOQ&amount=9]

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/Header.png]
We need a candidate who can win!
To create unity in our rural district, it's crucial to defeat MAGA-extremist Rep. Jack Bergman.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julyad [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julyad]
That's precisely why I'm running again. We have the best opportunity to send Bergman packing from Northern Michigan and the UP back to his real home in Louisiana.
____
We're on a roll! We are only $2,000 away from reaching our grassroots goal for the quarter before our FEC deadline at midnight.
Whether it's $3, 30, or $300, every dollar is making a difference in this crucial fight. I'm beyond grateful. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julyad]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julyad]
Friends,
I'm on the second leg of a two-cycle strategy to defend Democratic values and move rural America forward.
Last cycle, we established and accomplished a lot - Statistically, as a first-time candidate, the odds of defeating a four-time incumbent are less than 1%. But, by running again, those odds are drastically increased.
In fact, one year here, in the same scenario, keeping faith in second-time challenger put us within half a percentage point of defeating the GOP.
Bergman has never faced a second-time challenger. This is our year, and to get there, we need resources to send us across the finish line first.
Our campaign is fueled exclusively by thousands and thousands of grassroots supporters chipping in what they can, when they can. Not corporate PACs, no dark money. Just hardworking, everyday contributors joining the fight. And, as of April, we have more in-district donors than Bergman!
We have a clear path to victory and we cannot lose momentum.
Let's go win an election!
-Bob
Bob Lorinser
Candidate for US Congress
Northern Michigan / Upper Peninsula
Democrat, MI01

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: You know who’s NOT on this list?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
It’s a stark contrast, and I’d pick this team any day of the week.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2256%2E4032634%2E3IMJkZ)
---
Here are a couple of things I was very glad to learn recently: Out of all the donations our campaign has received during this fundraising quarter, the majority have come from nurses, teachers, social workers, artists, and retirees, to name a few. (In case you didn't know, campaign donors are required to list their occupation information — it's just one of the ways the FEC ensures campaign finance standards.) And our average contribution has been $25. We’re building a grassroots movement funded by grassroots donors who know we need to put more power in the hands of working people. Who are passionate about ensuring and providing health care as a basic human right. Who fight for every child to get a great education. Who look after families so they can get the support they need to thrive. Who bring light to our lives. Who’ve worked hard, and raised families, and strengthened their communities — and know firsthand the importance of bedrock promises like our government’s commitment to Social Security and Medicare. Who know that we can fight back against powerful interests like the gun lobby, Big Pharma, and fossil fuel giants. This campaign is funded by the people, and we’re fighting to make our government work for the people. [**Will you continue to fight as part of this dedicated team by making a donation of $25 or any amount by tonight’s end-of-quarter fundraising deadline? Every contribution will make our public FEC report that much stronger and show what we can achieve when working people band together.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2274?t=8&akid=2256%2E4032634%2E3IMJkZ) | _If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically:_ |
---
| [DONATE NOW: $25](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2283?t=10&akid=2256%2E4032634%2E3IMJkZ)
---
| [OTHER AMOUNT](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2284?t=12&akid=2256%2E4032634%2E3IMJkZ)
---
---
I was heartened to learn more about the people who’ve recently donated to this campaign. We’ve got a terrific, unique team — Meals on Wheels drivers, blacksmiths, librarians, cheesemongers — and I’m deeply grateful for you and everyone else who makes this movement possible.
**By the way — you know which professions _aren’t_ on the list of our donors?**
Federal lobbyists. Big bank executives. Executives from Big Ag, Big Tech, Big Pharma, hedge funds, fossil fuel companies, health insurance companies, or private equity firms.
That’s intentional. I don’t take donations from them, and I’m fighting to make sure Washington doesn’t only work for them.
But make no mistake: they know where to put their money.
Recently, a Super PAC started up to support one of my GOP opponents. It’s a vehicle for national Republicans, special interests, Big Tech moguls, Wall Street executives, and far-right ideologues to pour large sums of money into this race.
And they’ll be scouring our public fundraising reports for any signs of weakness and opportunities to invest more into this race.
After tonight, we’ll have to close the books on this quarter’s fundraising report. So let’s show them what this grassroots team is made of, and make it as strong as possible.
[**If it makes sense for you right now, please make a donation of any amount to fight alongside all the nurses, teachers, social workers, artists, retirees, and more who are funding this campaign. And let’s show that when working people fight, working people win.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2275?t=13&akid=2256%2E4032634%2E3IMJkZ)
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth

I’m all about getting stuff done, and do you know who gets stuff done for Pennsylvania’s working families? Our senior Senator and my good friend, Bob Casey.

| Fellow Patriot,

You've probably noticed that children today aren't getting the same kind of education that you and I received when we were growing up.

We used to be taught to love our nation, cherish our history, and respect our fellow Americans. But all of that has changed.

In today's classroom, children are taught that America is fundamentally racist, that our history is one of oppression, and that we should focus on our differences instead of what unites us.

[](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=bcb0b6287dd34f2384c2d4070d0a4c58&_e=2Wa7a_QcMUjNlld06UkR9YyFdEeG1eeydWLxmWFVT8lAtiXxiGWgVEuRP1Gk27CE4GL1jtX2N-l-GMC4NOsCcx224FgHI_VzD7sXdR0y6RIFZXR5Jlm3v9YbV7eNwBkycSTRKxRe6WQsvBlGDvkyBvBqteEXs9ezqeGPbJzaqW44T60KO-CNmmuzyLUq2AplrVz3anS43GrWBHPt3n6nSWUEsVgd6AzgGReGTVMla3GMp6rlSEXnJQfIeueZyKoE6EDV2xdtWjaOXkxRW_xZo6z4t_4qC2cuprZRaOOMc6D89F8MJhITpL50pO1FhWbDIXM-F3t8fACPiRIE4KRSLqWBEW4tvETLB4YlnmeVtmpbACDF9Ha6sKQP3r7a-246o_tS6ji7wRAQa5zEb0rfyQ%3D%3D)
__To make matters worse: the right of parents to choose how and where their kids receive their education remains out of reach for most American families.

And this is exactly why we created our Little Patriots program--to give parents, grandparents, teachers, and caregivers a free online resource they can use to teach children unbiased civics lessons, history, and American values, anywhere and anytime--[completely free of charge.](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=bcb0b6287dd34f2384c2d4070d0a4c58&_e=2Wa7a_QcMUjNlld06UkR9YyFdEeG1eeydWLxmWFVT8lAtiXxiGWgVEuRP1Gk27CE4GL1jtX2N-l-GMC4NOsCcx224FgHI_VzD7sXdR0y6RIFZXR5Jlm3v9YbV7eNwBkycSTRKxRe6WQsvBlGDvkyBvBqteEXs9ezqeGPbJzaqW44T60KO-CNmmuzyLUq2AplrVz3anS43GrWBHPt3n6nSWUEsVgd6AzgGReGTVMla3GMp6rlSEXnJQfIeueZyKoEXIMp3vBExIzh3BHPAfKiL0bt7FL5nKX3FbQJyq01l_nWQxHoTx0PD_u6Wuqo0ECh_HipY7Hdo27bD99ovhqDJXT2mTyf3WpGRU2tlhbPt9ijLMGCkF5tINTJt8l08lv-zTMatoptxQjBIatD11k9rw%3D%3D)

**And now we plan to do even more.**

To meet the growing demand for educational resources that teach children to love their country and its history, we're taking Little Patriots on the road to bring these educational resources to schools, churches, and community organizations!

But to help us fund this coast-to-coast effort, I need your help today.

We depend on the generous support of patriots like you to help us fund this program and share it with children and families across our great nation.

If you believe that American children deserve to receive the best education possible, [can I personally ask you to help me accomplish my goal of getting this first-of-its-kind curriculum to anyone who needs it?](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=bcb0b6287dd34f2384c2d4070d0a4c58&_e=2Wa7a_QcMUjNlld06UkR9YyFdEeG1eeydWLxmWFVT8lAtiXxiGWgVEuRP1Gk27CE4GL1jtX2N-l-GMC4NOsCcx224FgHI_VzD7sXdR0y6RIFZXR5Jlm3v9YbV7eNwBkycSTRKxRe6WQsvBlGDvkyBvBqteEXs9ezqeGPbJzaqW44T60KO-CNmmuzyLUq2AplrVz3anS43GrWBHPt3n6nSWUEsVgd6AzgGReGTVMla3GMp6rlSEXnJQfIeueZyKoEX-2OTteTyvwwNRsgZHy53vEIR_gospPam0-3BoPkxt8rwNf8nm3ABYZdtmLdl3tfSy7lEowP0ZD4ZQcRvJzRm02R7J3bgGzOeOG5flsDN0ZD5sBAMV2D01MaeY-_QW6qCcVmNDTQW7FfBd3L4_Ka5w%3D%3D)

### **Today Is The DEADLINE — Help Us Take Back Our Seat!**

Dear Friends,

**Today is the day!** Our reporting deadline passes at midnight, and we need your help to cross the finish line strong. This is your last chance to contribute and help our quarterly report come in strong. Your support will make a significant impact on my campaign for Congress.

I'm committed to standing up for Alaska in Washington, but we can’t do it alone. Your support today will help us show the strength of our movement and our determination to fight for Alaskan values. Together, we can take back our seat from Joe Biden's close ally, Mary Peltola, and ensure our voices are heard in Washington.

This is how we send a message they'll hear in DC: **Alaska's seat isn't theirs, it's _ours_. They don't get to tell us who our Congressman will be.**

Please, make your donation now. Every contribution is vital, and with your help, we can continue the fight to be the champion Alaska needs.

**[Click here](https://alaskansfornickbegich.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8aeb8c45837a089b0eee9add8&id=71a9c918c2&e=6679001ba0) to donate today!** Your donation will be put to good use as we push back against Biden's anti-Alaska agenda and his enabler Mary Peltola.

| | Dear Fellow American, American civics education, and specifically the teaching of American history, is at a crisis point. In K-12 schools nationwide, false narratives are being constructed, and content is being cherry-picked to fit an ideological (and frankly anti-American) agenda. Maybe you've even seen this happening in your local schools. As a result, we are faced with a choice: will we allow our children to be indoctrinated using curricula developed by anti-American ideologues and promoted by Left-wing education bureaucrats? Or will we insist that our children are taught honestly, using a curriculum that presents a fair, unbiased, and comprehensive view of our nation's history? We must insist on the **latter** , both for the sake of truth and for the sake of our children and America's future. For this reason, we have produced the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ --and I'm writing to ask your help in promoting this curriculum to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide. **What is the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_? ** The**_Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_** is a K-12 history and civics curriculum that covers the triumphs and tragedies of American history fairly and comprehensively. This curriculum has been designed not by activists or ideologues but by teachers and professors at Hillsdale College--and we are making it available **free of charge**. To be clear, the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ is not a _slap-dash_ response to the efforts of anti-American ideologues to indoctrinate our children. It is a 2,000-page, 85-lesson curriculum based on decades of studying American history. Developed over 18 months of intense and focused effort, its roots extend as far back as the beginning of Hillsdale College in 1844. And we need your help to make the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ available to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide...and to make it available **free of charge** so that it will have the greatest impact. _We have set a budget goal of $800,000 to promote the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ and our other outreach efforts--including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and our classical K-12 charter school initiative_. That's an ambitious budget, and we need to get started as soon as possible. One reason why your support really matters: **Hillsdale College refuses to accept one penny in taxpayer support --not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans**. This makes our work uniquely dependent on the support of citizens like you--citizens who agree with Hillsdale's mission on behalf of liberty. We remind ourselves daily of Hillsdale's 180-year-old mission--to provide "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty." subject: Why I chose to run

body:
https://www.perelesformissouri.com/ [https://www.perelesformissouri.com/]
Peter,
You have heard a lot from me and my team lately. And I want you to know that I appreciate you. I am so grateful for your involvement, your willingness to stay engaged and stay in the fight to make our state, and our country, better.
Those ideals are why I am running for office at all. The reason I am here is actually pretty simple (although it was definitely not an easy decision to make): this is not the state where my wife and I raised our family. This isn’t the same place that gave us so many opportunities to get a quality education, to build businesses and succeed, and to grow and plan our family life privately—without intrusion from our government.
Living with extreme laws...dysfunction that takes away people’s rights...this isn’t the kind of future we want for our two young granddaughters. I feel called to serve at this moment to do everything I can to help ensure the future for our family and yours are filled with promise and opportunities.
That’s why we have been reaching out even more as this important fundraising quarter comes to an end. In two weeks, we will file our public report that will show not only how much money we raised overall, but how much support we have, including how many individuals believe enough in our shared cause to lend their support.
There is a lot at stake right now, not only in Missouri but across the country. But we have a very rare chance to come together and shift the balance of power away from dangerous extremists who relish causing us chaos and misery, and toward decent people who will work to solve problems.
Achieving that goal is so important for the future we want for our children and grandchildren, Peter. We truly can do so much better. If you are able to help us out before our deadline tonight at midnight, you can contribute securely at the following personalized link: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perelesformissouri24?refcode=eoq2-4-final [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perelesformissouri24?refcode=eoq2-4-final]
Thank you so much for your support. I look forward to continuing my life of service in the State Senate to make life better for everyone here.
In Gratitude,
Joe

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=new_matching_funds_by_jill&n=1)

Peter, _**First, the great, amazing, awesome news.**_ WooHOO!! Our long awaited matching funds have been approved! In fact, the FEC wrote to request banking information to start transferring the first payment. **Then there's this.** Just after emailing that our matching funds would soon be on the way, the FEC oddly sent a second email claiming **no payments could be made until August, after the nominating conventions.** (This is allegedly to allow the FEC to determine whether candidates will apply for matching funds for the general election.) Our attorney is on the case. No mention was made of such a rule in our two previous campaigns that qualified for primary matching funds. So perhaps this is a bureaucratic error we can expeditiously correct. But in the meantime, **this leaves us high and dry** for hundreds of thousands of dollars already owed for petition drives. And, we must raise hundreds of thousands more in July to complete our ballot drives. In other words, we need your support now so we can continue the ballot drives -- while we fight for the funds we've been promised. Without an immediate major boost, we're at a standstill and will miss many imminent petition deadlines. We're on the ballot for a majority of voters. **But to truly challenge empire, we need an anti-genocide, pro-worker, climate emergency choice on the ballot for nearly all voters. To: dpwillis67@gmail.com
If you can spare a quick minute, Peter, I’d love to tell you why we set a $500,000 FEC End-of-Quarter Goal, and where that money is going when we hit it.
But if you’re in a rush — _or you’re already sold and ready to do whatever it takes to defeat Republican Larry Hogan and keep Maryland blue_ — **[feel free to chip in a quick $25 before our midnight filing deadline!](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27285?t=17&amount=25&akid=1927%2E52803%2EYlFLZN)**
| | [Donate $25](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27285?t=18&amount=25&akid=1927%2E52803%2EYlFLZN)
---
| | [Other Amount](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27285?t=19&amount=35&akid=1927%2E52803%2EYlFLZN)
---
Let’s start with the obvious: $500,000 is a big, ambitious goal.
_But here’s the thing: With the Senate majority on the line and Larry Hogan courting the far-right for support,**big** and **ambitious** goals are what it’s going to take to win._
As for how that money will be spent? Well, I could just say we’ve got a lot to do to set ourselves up for success over the next few months, but it might be easier to give you some specifics:
_**We need to ramp up our voter outreach efforts.** That means knocking on doors, organizing phone banks, and talking to folks in their communities._
_**We need to recruit and organize volunteers.** We’ve got to train folks how to talk about the race, lay out the stakes of the election, and make the case for our Maryland-first message._
_**We need to continue building up our team.** I’m surrounded by an amazing, dynamic team, but we need to hire and train even more staff to expand our capabilities._
_**We need to maintain an efficient, effective digital presence.** That includes email, texting, ads, you name it._
And so, so much more.
**[Whether or not we hit this $500,000 FEC Goal will have far-reaching consequences for the rest of the race, which is why I’m asking: Can I count on you to chip in $25 toward our goal before our midnight deadline?](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/27285?t=20&amount=25&akid=1927%2E52803%2EYlFLZN)**

Hi Peter, it’s Carole King 🎶 and I’m personally writing this email.
When I was in public school in Brooklyn, New York, I learned that Pennsylvania was the Keystone State and that a keystone is the central, wedge-shaped stone in an arch without which the arch would collapse.
[**Bob Casey is a keystone in the U.S. Senate. Will you join me in supporting his re-election?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240630-4?recurring=1&refcode=em20240630-4&refcode2=3426_552475_IBh0Fq&akid=3426%2E552475%2EIBh0Fq)
As a member of our narrow Democratic Senate majority, Bob serves on four committees to protect Pennsylvanians’ paychecks, pensions, Social Security, and our very democracy. And he fights every day to lift working families.
Bob voted FOR the American Rescue Plan Act, the Inflation Reduction Act, the CHIPS and Science Act, and the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law. Last year, he worked with President Biden and Governor Shapiro to accelerate the restoration of I-95—and he credits and supports the workers who got it done in record time!
[**Will you join me in donating $5 or whatever you can afford right now to re-elect Bob Casey? If you’re ready to click now, thank you so much, and enjoy the rest of your day.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240630-4?recurring=1&refcode=em20240630-4&refcode2=3426_552475_IBh0Fq&akid=3426%2E552475%2EIBh0Fq)
Bob lives in Scranton, Pennsylvania, and he’s on the side of Keystone Staters.
Casey’s Republican opponent lives in Connecticut in an enclave on the Long Island Sound where the water meets wealth, and the wealthy meet each other.
The Connecticut candidate is on the side of lowering taxes for American oligarchs, and he’ll jump as high as the Florida felon tells him to.
Casey’s opponent doesn’t care about the people of Pennsylvania. Bob Casey does.
When I met with him recently, Bob spoke of his deep concern that childcare is so expensive for working moms and dads in his state. Senator Casey believes that parents should be able to have a family AND be part of the workforce—and he’s determined to solve this problem.
[**We all need to pitch in to keep Bob Casey in the Senate. Will you join me?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240630-4?recurring=1&refcode=em20240630-4&refcode2=3426_552475_IBh0Fq&akid=3426%2E552475%2EIBh0Fq)
_Please use the links in this email to start a monthly donation through ActBlue._

---
Republicans are on a mission to take away women’s rights. If God forbid Senator Casey loses his seat, the cruelty crowd will have even more power to take away more of our rights.
[**Let’s use our grassroots power to re-elect Bob Casey to the Senate and keep Republicans at home where**** _they_****belong.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240630-4?recurring=1&refcode=em20240630-4&refcode2=3426_552475_IBh0Fq&akid=3426%2E552475%2EIBh0Fq)
Peter, it’s easy to think you can’t make a difference. But I’ve worked with many campaigns, and I can tell you that small donations add up, and the money you give today will help Bob’s campaign educate, organize, and motivate more voters.
I hope you’ll stay involved and continue to help in whatever ways you can.
Whatever you do, don’t give up. We can do this.
With gratitude and best wishes to you and your family,
— Carole

subject: Asking you to support Ruben Gallego in Arizona
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
As a filmmaker, I've always been deeply interested in the moments that defined the American spirit — the Civil War, the Great Depression, the Second World War, the Vietnam War, the Civil Rights Movement.
#

---
Hello, Peter. This is Ken Burns.
As a filmmaker, I've always been deeply interested in the moments that defined the American spirit — the Civil War, the Great Depression, the Second World War, the Vietnam War, the Civil Rights Movement.
These were inflection points where we were forced to live up to the essential promise of our nation: preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
As Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
Today, we face a new generational challenge. Our system of government is in great peril. The democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It has never been more important that we come together to ensure that our republic endures for future generations.
To meet that challenge, we need leaders who understand how important our democracy is and what it truly means to serve. That's why I’m writing to you on behalf of Ruben Gallego. Ruben is the son of immigrant parents, the first in his family to go to college, a Marine veteran, and a father.
His opponent, Kari Lake, attacks our elections at every turn. She sows the very same discord that is tearing our country apart. She is dangerous. Where Ruben would unite us, Kari Lake seeks only division.
We need more people like Ruben serving our country, and it would mean the world to me if you could support his campaign.
[**Can you make a donation of $25 or whatever you can afford to Ruben’s campaign for U.S. Senate in Arizona? This is a critical moment for our country, and I would not ask for your help if this were not so important.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-june24.NmHAEe&refcode=em240630-4-120&t=2&akid=2561%2E734936%2EwMSOk5)

To sum it all up, I have been working hard to fight for the people that elected me. But that also means I can’t spend as much time focusing on my reelection campaign and fundraising. And my MAGA competitor has been using that to his advantage. This campaign was built from the ground up by grassroots supporters, like you, chipping in a few bucks at a time when they can. My MAGA competitor can't say the same. He’s self-funding his campaign with hundreds of thousands of dollars of his own money. The only way I can compete with that kind of money is if I have your support every step of the way. Tonight, we have an opportunity to prove that I have a coalition behind me ready to fight for California, the accountability of lawmakers, and a better country. And if we put up the strongest numbers we can on our FEC report, we will prove the depth of grassroots support we have for our movement. So as we approach our FEC deadline at midnight, I am asking: = = I am grateful for the support this team has given me so far and I will continue to fight for Americans, our democracy, and the accountability of lawmakers as long as I serve in Congress. Thank you, Robert Garcia * Paid for by Robert Garcia for Congress Robert Garcia for Congress 65 Pine Ave #348 Long Beach, CA 90802 United States This email was sent to . | | We find ourselves at an alarming – and decisive – moment in American history. **Donald Trump is once again the presumptive Republican nominee for President despite (or perhaps because of) running on an openly authoritarian platform.** He's promised to pardon the January 6th insurrectionists. His campaign last month shared a video featuring a headline about a "unified Reich." He's detailed plans to purge the civil service of anyone who doesn't show complete loyalty to him or his extremist agenda. And he's even talked about circumventing the Constitution to serve a _third term_. **Republicans have closed their ranks around Trump in rapid succession, and he's polling competitively to potentially**** _win_****in November.** That means we could be looking at another Trump Presidency with a GOP-controlled Congress that's doubled down on the MAGA agenda, and will go to even more extreme lengths to advance it. I am determined to stop this from happening. But I need you with me if we're going to take on the Trump machine all the way through Election Day. [**It's critical that we close this month – the last month before the next FEC reports are released – on a high note. This was the day that Gabby Giffords founded Americans for Responsible Solutions, the organization now known as GIFFORDS. Since then, we’ve been working to elect gun safety champions up and down the ballot, help pass gun safety legislation nationwide, and organize a community of supporters who are all united behind the common cause of keeping our communities safe from gun violence.
**June 30, 2024**

The choice is yours, but we hope you’ll decide that today is the day you will step up and make your first online contribution to GIFFORDS PAC. You are going to see some repetitive content here. Because we are short of volunteers, we often fall short of our objectives to spread the word about freedom, opportunity, and prosperity because we are away, or otherwise committed.

**PARENTS! LEARN
ABOUT & JOIN
"MOMS FOR LIBERTY"
IN OHIO!**
---
|
Are you tired of feeling like you’re alone in your concerns for the future of your children?

Do you try to speak to community leaders about your concerns and your voice goes unheard?

There is power in numbers and Moms for Liberty (M4L) is putting up the numbers! The purpose of Moms for Liberty is to fight for the survival of America by unifying, educating, and empowering parents. Moms for Liberty are Moms, Dads, Grandparents, Aunts, Uncles, and Friends joined together to stand up for parental rights at all levels of government.

Moms for Liberty is a boots-on-the-ground organization. Join them and you'll be asked to show up to school board meetings, speak out in public gatherings, and do whatever it takes to stand up for our children. Our voices need to be heard and change will only happen through taking action!

Find and join a chapter today! Moms for Liberty Chapters: [**https://www.momsforliberty.org/chapters/**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=c5f0a8686c&e=5c740fa3e2)

If you do not see your county listed, consider starting one! [**https://www.momsforliberty.org/start-a-chapter/**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=5fd819f990&e=5c740fa3e2)

If you have any questions on joining or starting a chapter, contact Ohio M4L Ambassador Sarah Simon with any questions: [**sarah@momsforliberty.org**](mailto:sarah@momsforliberty.org)

THANK YOU!

CHINA'S SILENT WAR ON AMERICA!
WEEK 6 • LESSON 6**

|
In May we sent out a one-time special message about a new initiative called "[**America for Americans**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=8218254185&e=5c740fa3e2)" designed to wake up more Ohioans to the threat China poses to our communities, state, and nation. If you haven't seen that message, you can access a copy of it on the web [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=122a7c3f26&e=5c740fa3e2).

Part of this initiative is an Ohio-developed, 10-week "course" titled “**China’s Silent War on America** ”. A lesson will be released every week for 10 weeks. To remind you, we'll highlight new lessons in this email. Last week we highlighted **[Lesson 5](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=584bf56adb&e=5c740fa3e2).** This week, we're highlighting [**Lesson 6: China’s Takeover of America’s Farmland and the Global Food Supply.**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=f78a39e96c&e=5c740fa3e2)

[**America for Americans**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=fde274b5bc&e=5c740fa3e2) will provide a short lesson, one a week for ten weeks, to educate us on the many strategies China is using to undermine America’s power at home and abroad, while enriching its own homeland. The reader will also be guided towards action items to help reduce China’s influence in the state of Ohio.

Click [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=b7488ebb64&e=5c740fa3e2) or on the image below to access [**Lesson 6**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=e0819bc03b&e=5c740fa3e2) of “**China’s Silent War on America** ” called **"China’s Takeover of America’s Farmland and the Global Food Supply".**

_Next week's lesson, Lesson 7, will be the fourth of 6 lessons providing examples of China’s United Front's work in America and show how each of these initiatives undermines America’s national security._

THANK YOU!

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Don Davis for NC
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/94275/images/Updated%20logo.png]
Hey, this is Don Davis.
Growing up on a tobacco farm, I know firsthand the challenges our families face when it comes to making ends meet. I’m committed to finding common-sense solutions that help make life more affordable for everyone in our community.

Peter, when I was elected to Congress, I became the first openly gay person of color in Congress.

Today, there’s _**only 9** _LGBTQ+ Members of Congress out of 400+ in the House.

And as you can imagine, it’s not easy being in such a small minority. Especially when _**the other side doesn’t think you deserve the same rights**_.

It’s why I take my job so seriously. Because I am one of the few representatives who can fight for LGBTQ+ rights with personal conviction.

—So when Republicans spread transphobic hate, **I fight back.**
—When Republicans attack young LGBTQ+ students, **I fight back.**
—And when Republicans block critical legislation like the Equality Act, **I fight back.**

But Peter, until we flip the House, _Republicans will continue to hamper LGBTQ+ rights, abortion rights, voting rights, and more._

body:
Hi Derek, it’s
Alexander Vindman. I’m reaching out with an urgent request:

$10
contribution today between my brother Eugene Vindman’s campaign for
Virginia’s 7th congressional district and Adam Schiff’s campaign for
Senate ahead of their critical end-of-quarter deadlines?

If that’s all you need to hear, then please use this link to donate
directly:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=june2024_abs_em_vindman.biPLDf&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_EOQ_AC90_20240630_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=6852%2E5257348%2E8DJhXE ]secure.actblue.com/donate/june2024_abs_em_vindman?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com

Otherwise, please give me two minutes to explain why your donation today
is crucial.

Some of you may already know Eugene’s and my stories. But give me a moment
to refresh your memory:

In 2019, Eugene and I found ourselves in an unprecedented situation.

I overheard a shocking phone call between then-President Donald Trump and
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy. I listened to Trump pressure
Zelenskyy to investigate Joe Biden, using U.S. military aid as leverage.

It was an abuse of power I couldn’t ignore.

I turned to my brother Eugene, the ethics attorney at the NSC. Together,
we blew the whistle on Trump’s corrupt phone call and reported it up the
chain of command.

Eventually, I testified before a closed session of the House Intelligence
Committee.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=june2024_abs_em_vindman.eECn8y&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_EOQ_AC90_20240630_PM1_V1_S1&t=1005&akid=6852%2E5257348%2E8DJhXE ]Alexander Vindman

The man leading that committee was none other than Rep. Adam Schiff.
Adam's commitment to integrity and his fearless leadership resulted in the
first bipartisan vote in a Senate impeachment trial to convict a U.S.
president.

All three of us — Eugene, Adam, and I — did what we could to bring the
truth to light. But it did not come without consequences.

Trump retaliated, ending Eugene’s military career and mine. And since
then, Trump, the Republican Party, and right-wing media have targeted Adam
Schiff relentlessly, attempting to discredit and remove him from Congress
simply because he upheld the rule of law.

But Trump and the GOP cannot stop the pro-democracy movement Eugene and
Adam are building. We NEED leaders like Eugene and Adam in the House and
Senate fighting to defend our democracy, and they know it.

However, it won’t be easy.

Eugene and Adam both face a critical end-of-quarter FEC fundraising
deadline this Sunday, where they are legally required to report their
fundraising data. Trump and his MAGA GOP allies will be watching to see
just how strong our movements are, and we cannot afford to show an ounce
of weakness.

November and help us keep and take back the House and Senate majorities.

All three of us — Eugene, Adam, and I — did what we could to bring the truth to light. But it did not come without consequences. Trump retaliated, ending Eugene’s military career and mine. And since then, Trump, the Republican Party, and right-wing media have targeted Adam Schiff relentlessly, attempting to discredit and remove him from Congress simply because he upheld the rule of law. But Trump and the GOP cannot stop the pro-democracy movement Eugene and Adam are building. We NEED leaders like Eugene and Adam in the House and Senate fighting to defend our democracy, and they know it. However, it won’t be easy. Eugene and Adam both face a critical end-of-quarter FEC fundraising deadline this Sunday, where they are legally required to report their fundraising data. Trump and his MAGA GOP allies will be watching to see just how strong our movements are, and we cannot afford to show an ounce of weakness. [ ]So please, can you split a $10 contribution between Eugene and Adam’s campaigns today? Every dollar you give today will help them build the resources they need to win this November and help us keep and take back the House and Senate majorities. subject: 24-year-old me would not have imagined this
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| Hi friend, can I tell you a quick story about this photo? [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/71015?t=6&akid=15360%2E878179%2E2JUaWc) That's me in 1985 — just 24 years old at my law school graduation, fresh off a student research assistant job for Professor Laurence Tribe, thinking that I had just completed the toughest challenge of my academic career. Well, up to that point, anyway. (The bar exam was still a few weeks away).

Some years later, I would become an Assistant United States Attorney, and successfully prosecute the first FBI agent charged with espionage, Richard Miller, for spying for the Soviet Union.

As a new graduate of law school, I could never have imagined I would handle a case like that.

Or that I would later investigate a president who also betrayed our country ...

...lead his impeachment and Senate trial...

...serve on the January 6 Committee...

...get kicked off the Intelligence Committee by a craven Speaker of the House for doing the above...

...and get censured by extreme partisan MAGA House Republicans under the personal threat of that corrupt president...

Life leads us in uncertain and fortuitous ways. I’m fortunate that at a time when our country has been in trouble, and our democracy at risk, I have been in a position to help do something about it.

In the Senate, I hope to do even more.

[If you're able to, will you contribute a split donation of $10 between VPP and my campaign before tonight’s end-of-month goal to help me reach the Senate, defend our majority, and defeat Trump? **There’s an important U.S. Senate race happening in my home state this year that I think you need to know about.**
So before I ask you to support my friend Lucas Kunce’s campaign to defeat Josh Hawley and flip Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat, please let me explain why no one can afford to sit on the sidelines in this race.

Let’s start at the beginning. When I first got to know Lucas, his story resonated with me. He’s a born-and-raised Missourian who knows the real value of community — helping each other out, for better or for worse.
Growing up, his parents went bankrupt from his youngest sister’s medical bills and his family survived on the support of their friends and neighbors. After getting to college on a Pell Grant, Lucas decided to join the U.S. Marine Corps to honor the community that had given his family so much. He served for 13 years, including three deployments to Iraq and Afghanistan before later being stationed at the Pentagon.
Once he left active duty, Lucas turned his focus to the corrupt politicians and corporate monopolies that dominate our economy and squeeze small businesses. He took on everyone from Big Tech and Big Ag to defense contractors and pharmaceutical companies.
**Now, Lucas is running to defeat January 6th coward Josh Hawley and take back Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat for real, everyday people.**
| | [ELECT LUCAS KUNCE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87975067/482807164/-228879582?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk2600-bu-nd&recurring=0&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNzQwNmUyNi0yYzM3LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2q9hklIdvIa0uh7Jxc-BJXARLrqtn6XqJbuQNrnFCYY=)

**Since he was elected to office, Josh Hawley hasn’t fought to bring even $0.01 back to our communities — but he’s had plenty of time to make money for himself.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87975069/482807167/-228879582?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk2600-bu-nd&recurring=0&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNzQwNmUyNi0yYzM3LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2q9hklIdvIa0uh7Jxc-BJXARLrqtn6XqJbuQNrnFCYY=)
While giant corporations strip our state of opportunity and jack up prices, Hawley is only focused on enriching himself. He’s made hundreds of thousands of dollars more than his congressional salary by selling his weird book all about “Manhood.”
**All this, while he made taxpayers cover the cost of his own lawbreaking.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87975070/482807170/-228879582?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk2600-bu-nd&recurring=0&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNzQwNmUyNi0yYzM3LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2q9hklIdvIa0uh7Jxc-BJXARLrqtn6XqJbuQNrnFCYY=)
Missouri can’t afford another six years of Hawley in the Senate, friend, and voters of all stripes seem to agree.
**Morning Consult reported that Josh Hawley has the lowest approval rating of any Republican incumbent up for re-election this November.** And even Hawley’s own former mentor, Missouri’s three-term Republican U.S. Senator Jack Danforth, said supporting Hawley was “the worst decision I’ve ever made in my life.”
After spending a whole year consolidating support from workers, community leaders, and organizations across Missouri, Lucas Kunce has more than proved that he has what it takes to win this race. Multiple polls even confirm he’s in a dead heat with Hawley. That’s why I’m asking for your help, friend:

Peter, it’s Valerie Foushee. Whenever things get tough, or things look particularly hopeless, I like to turn to my favorite song, “Love’s in Need of Love Today” by Stevie Wonder. The lyrics ring true even now, almost 50 years after its release: _Hate's goin' 'round
Breaking hate's tried to break my heart many times _ **In this era of divided government and extreme partisanship, it can sometimes feel like there’s only hate.** I know I’m not the only one who gets frustrated in times of gridlock. But what keeps me going in this work, is a commitment to building a better future for our children, and a better life for our communities. If you send me back to Congress, that’s what I’ll continue to do. My FEC fundraising deadline is just a few hours away, and I still need to raise $2,398 to help close the gap. I wanted to make the biggest impact I could by standing up and being a voice for people in my community. That’s why I ran for public office and am running for Congress. Reporting strong fundraising numbers by this deadline will determine our options as we head into summer organizing efforts. It’ll also show our opponents and supporters where we stand, our chances of winning, and the strength of this campaign. If you want to help me make history as the first openly gay and Chinese-American representative from the Bay Area, then I need your support. = | | = | = | = | | = | = | = | = Gratefully, Evan | | = Paid for by Evan Low for Congress Evan Low for Congress 1700 Tribute Road, Suite 201 Sacramento, CA 95815 United States | = = | | Throughout his time in public service, Evan has defended our most vulnerable and built coalitions to deliver solutions. Now, he's running for Congress at an inflection point for Silicon Valley and the nation. Our region needs a representative who will lead on maintaining our global competitiveness, combat hate, stand up for the vulnerable, protect reproductive freedom, reduce crime in our communities, and ensure the middle class can once again afford to buy a house and raise a family where they work. Together, we will usher in a new era of courageous leadership for Silicon Valley. =**

body:
Control of the House of Representatives runs through California. We have more toss-up races than any other state in the country.

Hey there.
I know Democrats across the country are feeling anxious about this election and wondering if there's anything they can do to shape its outcome.
Here's something — and it's important — especially before tonight's FEC fundraising deadline ends:
Control of the House of Representatives runs through California. We have more toss-up races than any other state in the country.
If we win these races, Democrats can take control of the House. If we lose these races, there's almost no chance.
But in every instance, right-wing outside spending groups are targeting the Democratic candidate with ads to defeat them. So these candidates need our help to fight back.
This is a moment that reminds me of Bobby Kennedy’s speech at the 1964 Democratic Convention.
Bobby Kennedy said that JFK would have never been able to accomplish any of what he did without the support of all of you — the Democratic Party.
He said that when we’re in it together, we can accomplish a great deal. That remains true today, and it's the only way we'll take back the House this November: together.

Peter,

This is the last time I’ll email you before our FEC deadline expires. Thank you for standing with me in this critical time for our campaign to flip CA-27 – and the House majority – blue.

I never thought that I’d run for public office, let alone Congress. My career has been about solving problems in our community. From my time at NASA, to creating hundreds of jobs in the Antelope Valley, to speaking out about our wildfire crisis.

**Mike Garcia is a problem.**

He’s in the pocket of the extreme far-right. He’s more concerned about aligning himself with Trump and his special interest donors than improving our community.

Time and again he votes AGAINST our best interests. He voted for a national abortion ban. He voted to decertify the 2020 election results. He even voted to give himself a pay raise!

I’m tired of it. And with your help, we’ll rid our community of Garcia.

Hey — it's Jane. I know it's Sunday, and your inbox is probably overflowing with all sorts of last-minute campaign pleas. I know mine is. Listen, I really don’t like asking you for money. _Believe me, if I didn’t have to, I’d never ask again._ I want you to understand that even though we _have_ to ask a lot, I don’t expect you to donate to every single email or text you get from us. The truth is, you are an indispensable member of our movement, whether or not you can contribute financially. Your involvement — whether you prefer to write postcards, share our social media posts, or volunteer in some other capacity — helps us achieve our common goal of forcing government action on the climate crisis. What we do here is simple but powerful: elect climate champions who will hold Big Oil accountable and push for bold climate action. We combine direct financial support with grassroots efforts, focusing on down-ballot races where even modest contributions can make a big difference. **And we’ve already had some amazing victories this quarter!** In California, Big Oil buckled under the pressure and removed their dangerous referendum from the November ballot just hours before the deadline! They wasted $61 million to try to overturn a commonsense environmental law, but in the end — it was _our_ activism that prevailed. Thanks to the help of this community — two of our three Jane PAC-endorsed candidates in Colorado, Elliott Hood and Junie Joseph, won their primaries, and are one step closer to winning in November! **[But our ability to secure more victories like these depends on individuals showing up however they can. Tonight is our end-of-quarter deadline. So, if you've been considering making a contribution but haven’t been able to yet, now is the perfect time. You can use this link to chip in whatever you can before midnight tonight.
